findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: http_inspect · Private data: evm_units, x402_ping, x402_payment_preflight · Public sink: provider_bootstrap, http_inspect.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: http_inspect · Private data: evm_units, x402_ping, x402_payment_preflight · Public sink: provider_bootstrap, http_inspect

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
